principles.title: Safety
principles.description: Physical and emotional safety come first, for the person seeking support and for anyone helping them.

principles.title: Trustworthiness & transparency
principles.description: Being clear about what happens next, and not creating obligations someone didn't agree to.

principles.title: Choice
principles.description: The person decides the pace and the steps, wherever possible — support should not remove their agency.

principles.title: Collaboration
principles.description: Sharing power rather than deciding for someone what they need.

principles.title: Empowerment
principles.description: Building on a person's existing strengths and choices rather than treating them only as someone in crisis.

counselling.name: Vandrevala Foundation Helpline
counselling.description: Free, confidential mental health support and counselling.

counselling.name: iCall Psychosocial Helpline
counselling.description: Counselling support from trained mental health professionals, by phone or email.

community.title: Starting a support conversation with someone you trust
community.description: Guidance for telling one person — a friend, family member, or colleague — what's been happening, at whatever level of detail feels safe.

community.title: When harm affects a household or neighbourhood
community.description: Pointers for community elders, local organisations, or family members trying to support someone without taking over their decisions.
